name: Airport Tycoon✈️
desc:
✈️ Welcome to Airport Tycoon!

🛠️ [UPDATE 7]: WORLD 2! It's finally time! Travel to a new world and build an airport in a cozy, relaxing alpine mountain range.

🌙 Your airport earns while you are offline!

💾 Auto-saving progress!
💵 Build a GIANT airport!
🧳 Have hundreds of passengers in your airport!
🛫 Unlock HUGE planes!
🏝️ Unlock exotic destinations!

🤗 Playing with friends gives everyone bonuses! (+10% per friend)
⭐ Premium/Plus benefits: +15% money / +15% luck
💸 Like the Game & Join the Group for +1,000 money!
